name: Wix
description: Wix is a website-builder platform that lets users create professional websites quickly without coding skills, with hosting included.

pricing.starting_price: Free site available; paid-plan prices and currency vary by location

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: No credit card required; includes Wix hosting and editor. It is not a payment-enabled ecommerce plan.

tiers.name: Light
tiers.notes: Paid website plan for basic site needs; accepting payments is not listed for this tier. Pricing varies by location.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Adds accepting payments and basic ecommerce. Pricing and currency vary by location.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Adds standard ecommerce and broader business features. Pricing and currency vary by location.

tiers.name: Business Elite
tiers.notes: Adds advanced ecommerce and higher resource/collaborator allowances. Pricing and currency vary by location.

best_for: Wix positions itself for small business owners, entrepreneurs, creatives, and individuals seeking an accessible way to establish an online presence, including a free plan.

alternatives.name: Squarespace
alternatives.description: A template-driven website builder with integrated commerce and marketing tools.
alternatives.best_for: Entrepreneurs and creatives wanting a design-forward all-in-one site.

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: An open-source CMS with block editing and a large plugin ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting deep customization and self-hosting.

cons: The free Wix site is not a payment-enabled store; accepting payments and basic ecommerce require Core or a higher plan.
Wix states that prices and currency vary by location, and yearly subscription prices are paid in full at purchase, so a displayed monthly equivalent is not a universal monthly quote.
Advanced ecommerce is reserved for higher plans, so stores should match required commerce features to Core, Business, or Business Elite before upgrading.
